description: USDC and gas balance of any Solana or Base address, read from the chain: USDC amount, SOL or ETH for fees, whether the USDC account exists, and whether the wallet can pay a given x402 price. Lets an agent check its own funds or a counterparty before it pays. Price: 0.002 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"wallet_balance"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/wallet?address=CWfaj5vDppWCp4q1X4iPYGWpCGY2Rerj9DQWqxTnz1Pp

amount.description: optional USDC price to test, e.g. 0.01
